title: Bound shared-input Type A rank-17 root splits
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On the exact signed #7113 caller, neither initial same-mask pair (7,25) nor (10,28) permits a productive 17→8+9 split through invertible, body-independent central-even mixing within the pair. This tests the shared basis left open by #7510 while fixing the old paid itinerary. Both body orders and both first-body parity assignments fail at all 4,784 boundaries per pair.

The forward sweep exhausted all 38,272 exact pair/cut/order/parity cases. Each has a nonzero forbidden Gaussian-rational minor at q² = +1. The independent reverse sweep recovered the initial columns from the specified final diagonals, found forbidden rank two in both sectors for every case, and checked all 38,272 forward minors. Zero survivors and zero unresolved keys.

The exact #7481 gross bracket for one hypothetical paid-neutral split across all 96 Type A ports is (4.07820585157566, 4.07820585157568) raw before ancillary costs. Even four compatible splits would give less than 16.31282340630272 raw. One extra rank-one paid position per port costs 96. No split or saving was realized. A changed prefix, broader input mixing, and other phase, body, or rank contracts remain open.

## Source and overlap

Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, exact #7481 89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b, exact #7113 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d, and exact #7510 688470de6c16c90f2f446b348b768a55df8ba3e7. This refines p104-side-correction. The two #7257 CI prerequisites are separate ancestor commits. The exact source origins and digests are package-relative in PROVENANCE.json and PINS.json.

## Replay

From a clean POSIX checkout using CPython 3.12 and its standard library:

    python3.12 -I -B research/p104-type-a-rank17-shared-input-bound/replay.py

Expected PASS_RANK17_SHARED_INPUT_BOUND. Each scientific sweep has a 30-second cap and both exited zero. The verifier regenerates the forward journal and validates its canonical hash, normalized footer and every exact minor. Controls reject duplicate keys, changed caller bytes and a missing case, and exercise rank-one, rank-two and nonreal Gaussian determinant calculations.

Direct replay, registered replay, exact committed bytes and modes, source-history validation, official export and declared input coverage, read-only Git-free replay, and all 27 local onboarding tests passed on the exact submission tree cc9b3943408667a5f88f3663a55c228bf4ca82fa. Hosted verification is separate.

## Credit and next test

#7510 supplies the fixed-column predecessor, open shared-basis question and directed price receipt. #7398 supplies both Laurent engines, earlier bounded cuts and the prefix convention inherited from #7316. #7113 supplies the signed caller, #7481 the complete comparator and invoice, and #7298 the directed tariff. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging.

The next test should name an already-paid caller operation that can change the prefix, then check exact signed support at its sender and receiver by the first affected read before pricing a build.
